GRAFTMOU.AdoptFailed: {name} was imported, but could not be made a graft source: {reason}
GRAFTMOU.Adopted: {name} is now a graft source. Copy graft on it will name Moulinette rather than carry the document.
GRAFTMOU.NotIndexed: {path} is under Moulinette's folder but matches nothing in your Moulinette index, so the copied graft does not list it and a reader will not get it.
GRAFTMOU.NoCollection: Graft: Moulinette's cloud collection is not where this module expects it, so imports will not become graft sources. This needs updating.
